text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion is running in the Arima Kinen today, and her close friend Daiwa Scarlet is among the competition. And that's not all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur is racing too! She announces that has no intention of letting Fine Motion go home without a fight, and the pair trade taunts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's final race begins now!
